comment: This module and Taps share a name, a description and most of their code; the installed plugin.json gives both the same summary. Taps_Proto has no CV inputs, no modulation trimpots and no lights, and adds a mix output that Taps does not have. Its position knobs run from 0.1 rather than 0, and its clock handling has no multiplier: the loop is made exactly one clock interval long, where Taps scales the interval by the whole number part of its LENGTH knob. The knobs' tooltips are 'Length', 'Feedback' and two called 'Location', matching the panel's lower-case length, feedback and location lettering. The clock input has no lettering beside it on the panel; only its tooltip names it.
